### What is corporate travel management?

Corporate Travel Management (CTM) is a global leader in [business travel solutions,](https://www.travelctm.com/global/about/why-ctm-global-business-travel/) helping organizations plan, book and manage their travel programs. CTM combines innovative [travel technology](https://www.travelctm.com/global/travel-technology/) with personalized service to deliver savings, safety and a better travel experience.

### What is a travel management company?

A travel management company (TMC) is a partner that supports businesses with all aspects of corporate travel. TMCs provide [booking tools](https://www.travelctm.com/global/travel-technology/online-booking-tool/), global supplier networks, risk management, reporting and 24/7 traveler support to make business travel more efficient and [cost-effective.](https://www.travelctm.com/global/corporate-travel/savings/)

### Why choose CTM?

Companies choose CTM for our blend of innovative travel technology and [personalized service.](https://www.travelctm.com/global/corporate-travel/global-service/) We deliver cost savings, policy compliance, [traveler safety,](https://www.travelctm.com/global/corporate-travel/traveler-wellbeing/) travel reporting and actionable insights all backed by a dedicated service team in every region.
